# Shared public template, pinned and unchanged

`gems57/` and `template57/prepare_data.py` are exact source bytes from
[buffedlizard55-lab/57GEMSDOE at 822a0ce](https://github.com/buffedlizard55-lab/57GEMSDOE/tree/822a0ce5546c7b6749cdd82eb145b6b3e616603d).
The source/file hashes are in `registry/shared_template.json` and tested locally.

The TGJ31 runner uses the original cache builder, `spatial.folds`,
`evaluate_holdout.evaluate` / `pooled_summary`, `submission_writer.write_submission`,
and the literal `uniqueness` gate. This is an attributed immutable dependency, not a
separately maintained evaluator fork. No template bug was patched privately.
Owner-published code is not an organizer-authenticated scorer.
